$comment: Risk weighting profiles. There is no universal correct weighting -- a fintech backend and a marketing site should not share one. Pick a profile with --profile, or add your own. Weights are relative, not percentages; the engine normalises over the factors that actually have evidence.

confidence_bands.$comment: Inclusive lower bound on confidence -- the share of profile weight actually backed by evidence. A level is only as trustworthy as the evidence under it: 'critical' off one factor out of fourteen renders identically to 'critical' off thirteen unless the band is carried alongside it. Below `moderate`, the engine qualifies the level in risk_level_qualified and sets confidence_warning.

business_criticality.label: Business criticality of the affected capability
business_criticality.guidance: 1.0 = revenue/compliance path. 0.5 = important internal flow. 0.1 = cosmetic.

security_sensitivity.label: Touches authn, authz, secrets, crypto or session handling

user_impact.label: Breadth and severity of impact on end users if this breaks

data_sensitivity.label: Personal, financial or regulated data in scope

change_magnitude.label: Size of the change relative to the module
change_magnitude.guidance: Derive from diff stats; do not eyeball.

change_frequency.label: How often this area churns (hotspot signal from git history)

dependency_complexity.label: Number and depth of internal dependencies on the changed code

integration_complexity.label: Number of external systems involved in the behaviour

historical_failures.label: Past defects or incidents in this area

coverage_deficit.label: 1 - existing effective coverage of the changed behaviour
coverage_deficit.guidance: This is a deficit: higher means LESS covered, therefore riskier.

test_flakiness.label: Unreliability of the tests that guard this area

deployment_exposure.label: How quickly a defect reaches real users (continuous deploy vs. gated release)

irreversibility.label: Difficulty of undoing the effect (migrations, payments, emails sent)

external_system_dependency.label: Reliance on third parties that cannot be controlled in test

balanced.description: Sensible default for a general web application.

security-critical.description: Auth systems, payment rails, anything handling regulated data.

internal-tooling.description: Low blast radius, technical users, easy rollback.

prototype.description: Early-stage product where shipping beats certainty. Still weights security, because a prototype leak is still a leak.
